Risk Description: Unauthorized individuals may access business systems or sensitive company information due to inadequate access restrictions
Vulnerability: Weak access controls or inconsistent access reviews
Existing Controls: Access permissions are reported to exist but effectiveness has not been verified

Risk Description: Stolen credentials may allow attackers to access company email and cloud applications
Vulnerability: Insufficient authentication protection or user susceptibility to phishing
Existing Controls: Account authentication is in place but MFA coverage requires validation

Risk Description: Excessive administrator permissions may enable unauthorized changes or broad access to sensitive data
Threat: Malicious insider or compromised administrator account
Vulnerability: Excessive privileges and insufficient privileged-access reviews
Existing Controls: Administrative accounts exist; least-privilege implementation requires validation

Risk Description: Attackers may exploit known software vulnerabilities to compromise systems
Vulnerability: Delayed patching and incomplete vulnerability tracking
Existing Controls: Software maintenance activities are reported but patch compliance evidence is pending

Risk Description: Data loss or system failure may prevent timely recovery because backups may be incomplete or untested
Vulnerability: Backup coverage and restoration testing have not been verified
Existing Controls: Backup arrangements are reported but effectiveness remains unverified

Risk Description: Employees may disclose sensitive information or execute malicious files after deceptive communications
Vulnerability: Insufficient awareness or ineffective email protections
Existing Controls: Security awareness and email protection measures require validation

Risk Description: A supplier security incident may expose company information or disrupt business services
Vulnerability: Insufficient supplier due diligence and security oversight
Existing Controls: Supplier security arrangements have not been fully validated

Risk Description: Incorrect cloud permissions or settings may expose sensitive information to unauthorized parties
Existing Controls: Cloud services are in use but configuration effectiveness requires validation

Risk Description: Security incidents may remain undetected because relevant events are not monitored effectively
Vulnerability: Incomplete logging coverage or unclear alert response procedures
Existing Controls: Logging and monitoring capabilities require evidence-based review

Risk Description: Delayed incident coordination may increase the impact of a cybersecurity event
Vulnerability: Incomplete response procedures or insufficient response preparation
Existing Controls: Incident response arrangements require validation through documentation and testing
